## Accepted scope and retained limits

The four bounded r0.4 corrections are accepted: quantity-specific zero and
fixtures A–D, ECS evaluation order, empty-support references and exact cause,
and lifecycle/status deduplication and page flow. All 52 requirements, 25
predictions, settled scientific decisions and r0.3 architecture are preserved.
No new scientific derivation or substantive revision is authorized here.

This is acceptance of generic scientific authority. The candidate MAP/VAL
profile and source records will be preserved as proposed content in the generic
freeze only: separate
profile approval, Registry registration and source binding remain pending;
evaluability and object decisions remain unavailable. No final Registry
identity is assigned or activated. Previously admitted uniform `@draft-0.1`
identities and boundary `v0.2-draft.1/r0.4` retain their historical approvals
and evaluations. Every affected numerical route remains unavailable pending
separately authorized immutable identities, binding, registration, activation
and object-specific prerequisites.

The [scientific-contract charter](../../../README.md) requires a fresh
implementation-blind consistency review after owner disposition. That review
is now authorized; the earlier pre-owner review cannot satisfy it. This
acceptance record alone does not assert that the review or freeze has occurred.

No application work, implementation conformance, response/covariance fidelity,
observational validation, significance or production use is approved. Canonical
integration and cleanup are outside this operation. The NOI candidate remains
preserved and paused in this task; FRUIT remains independent and unfinished.
